system.description:
At 1st level, you gain one PP 1 Folkwarden Specialist Spell of your choice.
Folkwarden Specialist Spells are presented in Chapter 9 and concentrate on charms, remedies, wards, omens and practical Verdant workings.
Additional Folkwarden Specialist Spells may be learned through the normal Specialist Spell feat and Folkwarden class feats.

Use to choose your PP 1 Folkwarden Specialist Spell from the Grimoire (Bitter Charm, Blackthorn Warning, Hearthsign, Hedgeward, Red Thread, Steady Hands); Use again to change it.
